verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm that also ships client legaltech tools, so a bulk-operations question is applicable. The axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows a user performing bulk actions across many items. The SCC and Term Sheet generators are one-document-at-a-time questionnaires. The 'Evaluate' and Luminance mentions describe automated review, not user-driven bulk operations, so they are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
